```python
# Get all hotels in Paris
hotels_in_paris = get_all_hotels_in_city("Paris")

# Get the price and rating of each hotel
hotel_prices = get_hotels_prices(hotels_in_paris.split(","))
hotel_ratings = get_rating_reviews_for_hotels(hotels_in_paris.split(","))

# Filter hotels by price and get the one with the best rating
affordable_hotels = {hotel: price for hotel, price in hotel_prices.items() if float(price) < 210}
best_hotel = max(affordable_hotels, key=lambda hotel: float(hotel_ratings[hotel]))

# Get all restaurants in Paris
restaurants_in_paris = get_all_restaurants_in_city("Paris")

# Get the cuisine type and rating of each restaurant
cuisine_types = get_cuisine_type_for_restaurants(restaurants_in_paris.split(","))
restaurant_ratings = get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants(restaurants_in_paris.split(","))

# Filter restaurants by cuisine type and rating
french_restaurants = {restaurant: rating for restaurant, rating in restaurant_ratings.items() if cuisine_types[restaurant] == "French"}
best_french_restaurant = max(french_restaurants, key=lambda restaurant: float(french_restaurants[restaurant]))

# Get the price of the best French restaurant
restaurant_prices = get_price_for_restaurants([best_french_restaurant])

# Estimate the minimum cost for the trip
hotel_cost = float(hotel_prices[best_hotel]) * 3
meal_cost = float(list(restaurant_prices.values())[0]) * 2 * 3
minimum_cost = hotel_cost + meal_cost

print("Hotel name:", best_hotel)
print("Restaurant name:", best_french_restaurant)
print("Minimum cost for the trip:", minimum_cost)
```
